# R.J. Forbes Painting

> Premier industrial and commercial painting contractor specializing in surface preparation, protective coatings, and specialized restoration services across the East Coast.

R.J. Forbes Painting provides comprehensive coating and surface preparation solutions for commercial, industrial, and marine clients. The company serves major clients including Target Distribution Centers and marinas, offering specialized services from abrasive blasting to epoxy floor coatings and fire-protection systems.

## Key Topics

- Surface Preparation
- Abrasive Blasting
- Commercial Painting
- Epoxy Coatings
- Industrial Coatings
- Protective Coatings
- Dry Ice Blasting
- Concrete Grinding
- Marine Restoration
- Graffiti Removal
- Fire-Protection Coatings
- Waterproofing
- High-Heat Coatings
- Urethane Coatings
- Industrial Cleaning

## Surface Preparation Services

- [Surface Preparation Overview](https://rjforbespainting.com/service/surface-preparation): Surface preparation services: blasting, washing, grinding, ice blasting
- [Abrasive Blasting](https://rjforbespainting.com/service/surface-preparation/abrasive-blasting): Abrasive blasting for rust removal and coating preparation
- [Shot Blasting](https://rjforbespainting.com/service/surface-preparation/shot-blasting): Shot blasting for metal and concrete surface preparation
- [Dry Ice Blasting](https://rjforbespainting.com/service/surface-preparation/dry-ice-blasting): Non-abrasive dry ice blasting for eco-friendly cleaning
- [Concrete Grinding](https://rjforbespainting.com/service/surface-preparation/concrete-grinding): Concrete grinding for leveling and surface preparation
- [Pressure Washing and Water Jetting](https://rjforbespainting.com/service/surface-preparation/pressure-washing-and-water-jetting): Pressure washing and water jetting for surface restoration
- [Industrial Cleaning](https://rjforbespainting.com/service/surface-preparation/industrial-cleaning): Industrial cleaning removing contaminants and hazardous materials
- [Graffiti Removal](https://rjforbespainting.com/service/surface-preparation/graffiti-removal): Graffiti and vandalism removal with property restoration

## Coating Applications & Protection

- [Coating Applications Overview](https://rjforbespainting.com/service/coating-applications): Coating applications including epoxy, high-heat, and anti-graffiti
- [Commercial Painting](https://rjforbespainting.com/service/coating-applications/commercial-painting): Interior and exterior commercial painting with eco-friendly options
- [Epoxy Floor Coating](https://rjforbespainting.com/service/coating-applications/epoxy-floor-coating): Epoxy floor coatings for industrial and commercial flooring
- [Epoxy and Urethane Coatings](https://rjforbespainting.com/service/coating-applications/epoxy-and-urethane-coatings): Epoxy and urethane coatings for chemical-resistant protection
- [High-Heat Coating](https://rjforbespainting.com/service/coating-applications/high-heat-coating): High-heat coatings for extreme temperature protection
- [Intumescent Fire-Protection Coating](https://rjforbespainting.com/service/coating-applications/intumescent-coating): Intumescent fire-protection coating for structural steel
- [Insulative Coatings](https://rjforbespainting.com/service/coating-applications/insulative-coatings): Insulative coatings for energy efficiency and thermal protection
- [Anti-Graffiti Coating](https://rjforbespainting.com/service/coating-applications/anti-graffiti-coating): Anti-graffiti coating for vandalism protection and easy removal
- [Plural Component Spray Application](https://rjforbespainting.com/service/coating-applications/plural-component-spray-application): Plural-component spray application for high-performance coatings
